rationale: All storyboard beats present: frantic typing on three keyboards, chaos crescendo with hands thrown up, face-plant slump at the end. Golden-hour open-plan office and oblivious coworkers match reference. Key chat-bubble text legible in first half (URGENT!, ASAP, FEEDBACK?, DUE YESTERDAY!).
known_flaws: Some chat-bubble text garbles in the final seconds (FEBACK?, CRALNK?) and mid-scene bubbles briefly read as translucent soap bubbles; minor in motion, typical text-rendering artifact, not worth a $0.80 re-roll.
